# Version 3.119.2
> **Platform reliability update** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 improves platform support and hardens the Windows native binaries. It adds missing tvOS surface overloads, preserves Android symbols, and enables modern Windows exploit mitigations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **tvOS surface creation overloads completed** — Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS applications. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android symbols preserved in packages** — Android native symbols are retained to improve diagnostics for deployed applications. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## Security

- **Windows native binaries hardened** — Native DLLs enable Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks. — ❤️ [@Aguilex](https://github.com/Aguilex) ([#3397](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3397), [#3404](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3404))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

Updates the HarfBuzzSharp native-package hardening alongside the Windows binary mitigations.
